name: Speaking Things Into Existence
overview: Scripture reveals that God, the Creator, spoke the universe into existence, demonstrating the powerful efficacy of His word (Genesis 1:1). The Bible teaches that life and death are influenced by the words we speak, underscoring the weight of the tongue's power (Proverbs 18:21). God's spoken word never returns void but accomplishes His purposes (Isaiah 55:11; Ezekiel 12:25), and Jesus affirms that faith in God, expressed through prayer, results in receiving what is asked (Matthew 21:22; Mark 11:22). Thus, speaking things into existence is rooted in the authority of God's word and the believer's faith aligned with His will.
